identity.identity_label: author-owned official repository post-publication CPU implementation

runtime.upstream_license_status: no license file at pinned commit; upstream source, image, checkpoints, and data are not redistributable absent permission

protocol.source_training: official bundled binary-labeled news source data
protocol.target_adaptation_boundary: one fresh model trained and adapted separately for each target corpus and run
protocol.canonical_row_order: byte-frozen order of each canonical outputs/sentences/<corpus>.csv after excluding only rows invalid under the unchanged legacy one-physical-line input contract
protocol.legacy_order_sensitivity: all target rows enter shallow-feature normalization; only the first 50 valid target rows enter consistency batches because upstream train.py applies modulo 50
protocol.independence: separate Docker process and fresh training for every corpus/run pair
protocol.upstream_seed_behavior: NumPy and Torch are fixed at 1234 by upstream; Python random is intentionally unseeded and controls augmentation branches
protocol.primary_ko_aggregation: arithmetic mean of the three native posterior scores for each sent_id
protocol.training_variability: retain all run-level scores and hashes; report run-level corpus summaries and row-level across-run population standard deviation
protocol.strict_subset: join strict_natural_language_v1 score-blind keep status onto each already trained/scored original run; never retrain on strict rows
protocol.length_control: reuse round2_length_control_v1 exact-token common support, reference distribution, weighting, regression, interaction diagnostic, and bootstrap rules

coverage_gates.validity: nonempty corpus_id/sent_id/text, unique sent_id, and no CR or LF in canonical sentence text
coverage_gates.action_on_invalid_row: record failure and stop before any model run; no text repair or silent exclusion
coverage_gates.required_join: identical ordered sent_id sequence across canonical sentence, SpeciTeller score, features, strict manifest, and every Ko run

analysis.bootstrap_unit: doc_path cluster sampled independently within corpus
analysis.cross_model_agreement: within-corpus Spearman on identical rows; document-cluster bootstrap uses fixed full-sample average ranks and cluster resampling
cross_model_transforms: within-corpus average percentile ranks for disagreement
within-model pooled z scores for standardized corpus contrasts
analysis.native_scale_rule: never compare raw SpeciTeller and Ko values as interchangeable
within_model_outputs: corpus ordering on native mean and median
analysis.preprocessing_outputs: original and strict_natural_language_v1 summaries and Wikipedia-minus-technical document-bootstrap gaps
analysis.length_outputs: round2_length_control_v1 primary direct standardization and regression/interaction sensitivity for both model aggregates
analysis.disagreement_outputs: absolute within-corpus percentile-rank difference summaries and deterministic top sent_id diagnostics
analysis.accuracy_boundary: without labels, smaller gaps or stronger agreement are not evidence of greater accuracy
analysis.human_pilot: not run; optional only under existing plan and not required for this comparison

stop_conditions: canonical baseline checksum or ordered join failure
Docker image or external GloVe identity mismatch
scientific choice would need to change after outcome inspection
